reviewed_by: Codex review of October 12 failed release browser jobs and current theme tokens
reason: Six October 12 release jobs failed in the same Studio conversation test because it expected Zero Classic colors under the Zero Dark name. The studio-conversation catalog selects that palette journey and the related Workbench geometry journey on each of desktop and 320 px Chromium/WebKit, for six production-preview browser cases.
exclusions: This changes a stale mocked-browser assertion only. Python, frontend component, native, real-Core, and other Playwright areas are excluded; the daily release's impact gate remains authoritative. Mobile browsers are emulated, with no physical device available. No full suite is authorized.
